_instructions: This is a template — not used directly by the app. Copy this file,
fill in the real values below, delete this '_instructions' section,
and give the copy to a new user.
It never contains a username or password. Each new user always
creates their own admin account (if the data file is empty) or
logs in with an account you've created for them separately.
To load it: on the very first screen of the app, click
'Load connection profile (.json)' and select your filled-in copy.
mode: either "github" or "local" — delete whichever section
